body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-04-28 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "For FY '27, our capex guidance will be similar to previous years. It will be about INR250 crores. ... we'll be taking on another 75,000 plus 75,000 in the next 2 financial years in FY '27 and '28." Metric: Capex / capacity. Target: INR ~250 cr FY27; 525k t by FY27-end; 600k t by FY28-end. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Oct-26: the next blocks are greenfield, with land not yet identified; phase 1 by end-FY28, phase 2 by end-FY29; '600,000 tons by FY29'. The +75k t in FY27 is now only the delayed FY26 block. Capex ~INR 250-300 cr a year is in line.
